figures.cap: solution sketch: two semicircles of radius 2 on [-2, 2]: upper half centred (0,3) and lower half centred (0,5), both with range [3,5]

parts.latex: Find two possible equations of a semi-circle with range $[3,5]$, given that it is an even function.

solutions.latex:
\exfigure{335_q23_s1}

The function is even, so the centre lies on the $y$-axis, and the range $[3,5]$ gives radius $5-3=2$.

Option 1: centre $(0,3)$, concave down (top half of the circle)
$$y=3+\sqrt{4-x^2}$$
Option 2: centre $(0,5)$, concave up (bottom half of the circle)
$$y=5-\sqrt{4-x^2}$$
